detailed_descriptions.en: Don't Blush is an interactive FMV game focused on emotional connections, suspense, and puzzle-solving. Through interactions with six distinct heroines, you will gradually explore a hidden dimension known as the "Inner Realm" and unravel the mysteries surrounding you all. [A Journey of Emotion and Mystery] Your peaceful life is shattered by an unforeseen incident. As you encounter hidden anomalies, a mysterious figure guides you, awakening your ability to traverse the "Inner Realm." As you delve deeper into the investigation, you will meet a cast of characters with vastly different personalities, entangling you in a complex web of memories, emotions, and hidden truths. [Who is She, Really?] Gentleness coexists with distance; rationality intertwines with emotion. Each heroine possesses a distinct personality and a hidden past. Under certain circumstances, they will reveal a side quite unlike their daily selves. As your bonds deepen, you must decide: is this the real her, or just a facade concealing something else? [Choices Lead to the Truth] While exploring the "Inner Realm," your decisions will shape the course of your relationships and steadily unveil the reality behind the events. Every choice can alter the bonds you share with them and ultimately dictate the final outcome. In a world filled with the unknown and intricate emotional ties— You might just discover that the only thing more inescapable than the mysteries is the stirring of your own heart. New Interactive FMV game Don't Blush coming August 19th! Stay tuned!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Don't Blush is an interactive FMV game focused on emotional connections, suspense, and puzzle-solving.

Through interactions with six distinct heroines, you will gradually explore a hidden dimension known as the "Inner Realm" and unravel the mysteries surrounding you all.

[A Journey of Emotion and Mystery]

Your peaceful life is shattered by an unforeseen incident. As you encounter hidden anomalies, a mysterious figure guides you, awakening your ability to traverse the "Inner Realm."

As you delve deeper into the investigation, you will meet a cast of characters with vastly different personalities, entangling you in a complex web of memories, emotions, and hidden truths.

[Who is She, Really?]

Gentleness coexists with distance; rationality intertwines with emotion.

Each heroine possesses a distinct personality and a hidden past. Under certain circumstances, they will reveal a side quite unlike their daily selves.

As your bonds deepen, you must decide: is this the real her, or just a facade concealing something else?

[Choices Lead to the Truth]

While exploring the "Inner Realm," your decisions will shape the course of your relationships and steadily unveil the reality behind the events.

Every choice can alter the bonds you share with them and ultimately dictate the final outcome.

In a world filled with the unknown and intricate emotional ties—

You might just discover that the only thing more inescapable than the mysteries is the stirring of your own heart.

New Interactive FMV game Don't Blush coming August 19th! Stay tuned!
